description: Validate a Godot project import using its existing bounded CPU worker and current source revision
steps: Request the existing native watoom_game_worker import operation with a stable job identity after inspecting the project invocation.
Use the same job identity to read its terminal status; do not duplicate an admitted request or run import in the app shell.
Match the root-owned status and receipt to the current source fingerprint; require actual PASS and no import errors.
validation: Root-owned matching COMPLETED status, unchanged current source fingerprint, import PASS, source_unchanged true and empty errors. Import is technical evidence and does not establish visual acceptance.
recovery: Retain the original request, source and partial cache. Inspect its captured error evidence and repair the cause before requesting a new revision. Never delete caches or change GPU/model ownership automatically.

description: Verify Godot regression tests through the existing bounded CPU worker without changing the live project
steps: Discover and preserve the project's existing test invocation and success baseline.
Request the native watoom_game_worker regression operation once with a stable job identity.
Read the same job's root-owned current-revision receipt; require test success, no runtime errors, and an untouched original project.
validation: Current source fingerprint equals the matching root-owned COMPLETED status. Receipt PASS, exit_status 0, summary.failed 0, summary.passed positive, runtime_error_count 0, original_project_untouched true, and live_source_still_matches_snapshot true.
recovery: Preserve the worker snapshot and logs; inspect failed test and runtime-error examples. Correct only the task-owned cause, and rerun through the existing admission mechanism. No automatic infrastructure or permission changes.
